subject: Can we arrange legends in two (more) columns?

messages.author: 56f89e4e966f65cf
messages.subject: Can we arrange legends in two (more) columns?
parts:
Hi,

Has anybody met this issue that when you have too many group, your
legend will become a long vertical line.

How can we deal with this? Is it possible to arrange legend into two
or more columns?

Thanks！

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Can we arrange legends in two (more) columns?
parts:
Use the new version, still in development mode. See the help file of
guide_legend() to see what types of things can be done. Another source
with a few related examples is section 2 of the transition guide to
0.9.0, whose most recent version was posted here:
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/msg/2a6ab7a72e658c6d. Download
the attachment at the bottom. Hopefully, the guide will be posted on
GitHub within the next few days, but I have to do a few things first.

To download and use the new version, try the following:

library('devtools')
dev_mode() # should reply dev_mode: ON
install_github('ggplot2')
install_github('scales')
library('ggplot2')
library('scales')
<your code here>

Until the new version of ggplot2 is accepted by CRAN, this is how you
access and use the new version.

Dennis
